name: Utility
description: Some specific dialogs for utility entities.

lines.name: Road Sign
lines.text: AAAB Village. Straight ahead, along the road.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: No name. No direction. No promise of what lies further down the road.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: I found a key in the chestbox. I wonder what it's for. It's probably for some other chestbox.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Inside the chest, you discover old books and records of the Warriors’ Guild that once occupied this house.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Among the texts, you manage to find the name of the northeastern house — “assembly-hall.”

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: This information should prove useful.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: You have found the sword the guardsman spoke of. Its steel is engraved with ancient runes. You should deliver it to its rightful master.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: You don't have the key to the chestbox. You need to find it first.

lines.name: Voice of Reason
lines.text: You look at the path you’ve left behind. You have just come from there, and many experiences await you ahead.

lines.name: Voice of Reason
lines.text: It is not yet time to leave.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: It's empty. There's nothing here.
What a strange place — as if everything and nothing were fused into one. I see everything, I hear everything, but am I still myself, or something else?
Perhaps someone is watching me through this endless darkness. What am I?
A sense of emptiness. Weightlessness. My gaze passes straight through my hands. Do hands even exist?
Does anything I do truly exist? Does it have meaning, or is all of this just one vast theatrical performance?

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: You stand and stare at the doorway you just passed through. A moment of shock washes over you — the door is gone.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Strange streaks. Distortions. Emptiness. The door — or perhaps the space around it — has transformed into something unnatural.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: If there is a way out of here, it is certainly not one people are used to.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Perhaps the answers lie beyond the boundaries of the spaces we know.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: With a sense of unease, you notice that the voices that once echoed through the street have vanished. You can’t help but wonder: has the entire street disappeared as well?

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: What kind of space are we in now?

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: Deep within your soul, you feel that you must try something unconventional.

lines.name: Narrator
lines.text: To reach out and touch the darkness with your own very being.
